name: Button set generator
author: Lienzo UI
description: Creates ready-made groups of buttons (main menu, OK / Cancel, Yes / No / Cancel, tab bar) with layout groups, centered on the canvas.

commands.name: Main menu column
commands.description: Play, Options and Quit buttons in a Vertical Layout Group.

commands.name: OK / Cancel pair
commands.description: Two buttons side by side in a Horizontal Layout Group.

commands.name: Yes / No / Cancel row
commands.description: Three buttons in a Horizontal Layout Group.

commands.name: Tab bar (4 tabs)
commands.description: Home, Play, Shop and Settings buttons in a Horizontal Layout Group.
